description: Source code for HEVC (H.265) video codec utilities, including parsing and handling HEVC parameter sets and NAL units within the Android media framework.

classes.name: HevcParameterSets
classes.description: Class for managing HEVC parameter sets (VPS, SPS, PPS), parsing NAL units, and generating HEVC configuration data.

methods.name: addNalUnit
methods.description: Adds a NAL unit to the parameter set collection, parsing VPS, SPS, or PPS based on NAL unit type.

methods.name: findParam8
methods.description: Finds an 8-bit parameter value by key.

methods.name: findParam16
methods.description: Finds a 16-bit parameter value by key.

methods.name: findParam32
methods.description: Finds a 32-bit parameter value by key.

methods.name: findParam64
methods.description: Finds a 64-bit parameter value by key.

methods.name: getNumNalUnitsOfType
methods.description: Returns the number of NAL units of a specific type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of a NAL unit at a given index.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a NAL unit at a given index.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Copies a NAL unit's data into a destination buffer.

methods.name: parseVps
methods.description: Parses VPS NAL unit data to extract profile and level information.

methods.name: parseSps
methods.description: Parses SPS NAL unit data to extract video parameters.

methods.name: parsePps
methods.description: Placeholder for parsing PPS NAL units.

methods.name: makeHvcc
methods.description: Constructs an HEVC configuration box (hvcc) from stored parameter sets.

methods.name: IsHevcIDR
methods.description: Checks if the given HEVC data contains an IDR frame.

methods.name: FindHEVCDimensions
methods.description: Extracts width and height from an SPS buffer.
